The ACCC's decision to block Micro Star (KegStar) from buying Convoy—despite Convoy being in receivership and the deal being arguably preferable to the assets disappearing—signals a new line in the sand where the regulator is prepared to block deals even in extreme circumstances. This was historically unusual and represents a meaningful shift in regulatory risk for M&A participants.
quote: What really matters here was convoy was actually trading in receivership.
